record.rationale: Browser CSS URL cursor drawing projects native window state; policy remains in SwEditWin.
responsibilities: Iteration189 moves table pointer policy to native SwEditWin::changeMousePointer/GetPointer and actual SwCursorShell::IsTableMode instead of a browser SwTab switch. Resize hints are HSizeBar/VSizeBar with native table-mode suppression; enhanced selection retains five native TabSelect glyphs. VCL browser projection owns CSS only and static16x16 X11 source/mask pixels with native hotspots. Literal native enum/switch/owner/asset tests, mounted pointer and real Chromium1280/390 cover represented behavior. Object-selectable arbitration, LibreOfficeKit, remaining pointer families, physical RTL/vertical layout, actual resize drag and complete native window contracts remain unverified; no semantic promotion or registered save/open/recovery changes.

stackDivergence.rationale: CSS cursor resources replace native platform display API; native glyph pixels and hotspots are preserved.
